liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Ramble On Rose stood out, as did Looks Like Rain [34]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): The transition from Help to Slip to Franklin was awesome [30]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): These are considered the real Slipknot days alongside earlier years [32]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' into Black Peter and Not Fade Away was liked [34]
- **Revolution** (1 review): John Lennon would have been proud of the band's rendition [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-10-12.senn441.chasingwilma.101954.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 164 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1983-10-12.143609.fob.nak700.cohen.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 173 min [2]
- **gd1983-10-12.mtx.groves.92461.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 183 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: Recording provides a strong sense of being present at the venue [24]
- **gd1983-10-12.167753.senn441.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 180 min [8]
- **gd1983-10-12.senn441-u87.eaton.miller.91125.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 177 min; rated 3.62/5 by 8 [10]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is sufficient for a listener with tinnitus to hear songs [25]
- **gd1983-10-12.neumannU87-senn421.lance.30827.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 176 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: Warmest and clearest audience recording; SBD lacks drum echo [26]

## Around the show

- Band played with high energy in the city, not letting fans down [23]
- Babatunde Olatunjie and his band opened the show spectacularly [31]
- Playing was inspired, reflecting the band's supercharged nature in 1983 [27]
- This show was overall superior to the previous night's performance [31]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-10-12.senn441.chasingwilma.101954.sbeok.flac16**: taped by chasingwilma; transferred by chasingwilma; source: 3 sennheiser 441 > sony d-5 Recording Location: behind the soundboard [1]. Also: Setlist includes Cold Rain, Minglewood, Ramble On Rose, and Esau [1]
- **gd1983-10-12.143609.fob.nak700.cohen.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Cohen; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Cohen's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 > Sony D5 (patched out of Barry Glassberg) [2]. Also: Sennheiser 421 and Neumann U87 blend supplies a Drums patch [2]
- **gd1983-10-12.mtx.groves.92461.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See Notes; transferred by Jim Groves; source: SBD and Audience Matrix Mix of about 60% SBD to 40% Audience. [7]. Also: Audience tape by Rob Eaton; transferred and mastered by Charlie Miller; SBD lineage includes cassette master, two DAT generations, and CDR [7]
- **gd1983-10-12.167753.senn441.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob, Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441 mics + (1) Neumann U87 mic blend (mounted on soundboard) > Nakamichi 550 [8]. Also: Sennheiser 441 and Nakamichi 700 sources patch the Drums section [8]
- **gd1983-10-12.senn441-u87.eaton.miller.91125.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sennheiser 441 (1) Neumann U87 -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) -> Dat D(48k) D [10]
- **gd1983-10-12.neumannU87-senn421.lance.30827.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Greg Lance; source: FOB > 1 Neumann U87 + 2 Sennheiser 421's > Nak 550 (Master Cassette) > Dat [11]

Babatunde Olatunjie and his band opened the show spectacularly
